reviews.title: Fast SSD drive with cool LED lights on the heatsink
reviews.comment:
Device worked wonderfully! Easy to use needed to upgrade a failing SSD in a critical use computer. Fast large 2 TB drive size is great buy for the price and functionality! I purchased a second unit for another machine. It did not seem to overheat with the great heating included with the drive. I have been using this fast SSD for a few weeks now and I’m very happy with it. Great quality and well made. No problems so far.
Love the LED lights on the heatsink.
reviews.author: Robert bator

reviews.title: Amazing item and easy to install
reviews.comment: High quality packaging and it easy to install super fast moving large of files or copying games, even my motherboard is only support up to Gen 3 but it still very fast, I don't want to risk for testing about durability but it seems high quality the case itself on NVMe. 1GB is good enough for me to download more games than just having 2 games on 250GB ssd, I'm happy with this item
